candidates.what_happened: VP Land reported on 26 Nov 2026 (after Variety) that Maharaja in Denims, Intelliflicks Studios' feature-length generative AI film directed by Balpreet Kaur, will open in April 2027. It was made across Midjourney, Runway, Google Veo, Kling, Seedance 2.0 and Higgsfield, the stills for the whole film were redone three times as models improved, and the budget passed $500,000.

candidates.what_happened: On 17 Nov 2026 Spotify made Artist Profile Protection available to every artist. An artist who turns it on gets an email when music is delivered under their name and can remove themselves; by default the release still goes live, and an advanced setting blocks releases until the artist approves them. Billboard reported Sony Music had asked for more than 260,000 deepfake songs to be removed.
